# Vendored: CREATE

Source: https://github.com/ManyaWadhwa/CREATE (Wadhwa, Singha Roy, Lederman, Li, Durrett,
"CREATE: Testing LLMs for Associative Creativity", arXiv:2603.09970, 2026).

Vendored here (`path_evaluator.py`, `prompt_bank.py`, `creative_utility.py`, `inference.py`,
`prompt.py`) **with the author's permission** for the kg_creat track. Upstream has no explicit
code license; reused for research with attribution. Only intra-package import paths were changed
(made relative); logic is unmodified so results stay comparable to CREATE. Cite the paper above.
